description: Bounce a session (or specific tracks) to audio on the user's Mac — Dø Desktop renders them in the background WITHOUT the user opening the DAW (engine "headless"): each AUDIO track's regions as the arrangement places them, from bar 1, through the track's third-party Audio Units. Logic's own plug-ins and instrument/MIDI tracks render only inside Logic: each stem names the plug-ins it does not include (plugins_not_rendered), and an instrument track is reported, not rendered. engine "live" (Logic's own bounce) needs a live Logic connection, which the public Dø Desktop does not have. Each stem says its format: the requested wav/aiff, or "opus" when the plan cannot store lossless (the lossless file is then on the Mac at local_path). A track that could not render is named in the error with its reason. Async: returns a job_id — poll with doseedo_wait_task. The result is downloadable stem URLs. Needs Dø Desktop to run at some point to pick up the job; until then it stays queued. No credits (rendered on the user's machine). Cancel: a bounce still queued never renders (its budget is refunded); one mid-render has its result dropped on arrival.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

stems.description: true (default) = one file per track; false = a single mixdown.

tail_seconds.description: Extra seconds for reverb/delay to ring out (default 2).

track_ids.description: Tracks to bounce (t_… ids from doseedo_get_session). Omit to bounce the whole session.

name: doseedo_bounce_session
title: Bounce a session
